text:
mia: Noticed a recurring DX bug: our TS SDK generic overloads lose inference when consumed in edge ESM builds (Cloudflare/Vercel). Works in Node but in Workers the editor shows params as any.

ryan: Can you paste the exported type shape? Usually package exports/types resolution is the culprit.

mia: Minimal public API: 

mia: ```ts
export function run<T>(opts: { data: T }): Promise<Resp<T>>;
export function run(opts: { data: unknown }): Promise<Resp<any>>;
```

mia: Importing in an edge app: `sdk.run({ data: { id: 1 } })` shows data: any.

zoe: Two big suspects: 1) published .d.ts order (overloads reversed) 2) consumer resolving the wrong d.ts via package.json exports/types or bundler rewrite.

ryan: Are you using esbuild/tsup/rollup to bundle types? CI vs local can differ if one path regenerates d.ts.

mia: We generate d.ts via rollup-dts on publish; local dev uses tsc --declaration. CI publishes rollup output.

oli: Rollup-dts can reorder overloads. Best fix: emit types from tsc with --emitDeclarationOnly and avoid reserializing. Also provide explicit types mapping in exports so ESM consumers get the correct d.ts.

zoe: Example exports snippet that helps editors: 

zoe: "exports": {"import": {"types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts","default": "dist/esm/index.js"},"require": {"types": "dist/cjs/index.d.ts","default": "dist/cjs/index.js"}}

ryan: Or use typesVersions in package.json to guide TS based on compiler version. And bump minimum TS if you rely on node16/node20 resolution.

mia: Another approach is to avoid ambiguous overloads: prefer a single generic signature with constrained default or conditional type e.g. `export function run<T = unknown>(opts: { data: T & {} }): Promise<Resp<T>>;`

oli: Also add a tiny CI consumer test: a repo that imports the built package and runs tsc in a Cloudflare-targeted tsconfig to verify inference. Saves a lot of back-and-forth.

build-bot: ci: types-compat job queued for branch/edge-typing-fix (matrix: node16,node20,cloudflare,deno).

mia: Action items: switch to tsc emitted declarations on publish, add exports types mapping, add consumer test matrix, and try single-generic refactor. I'll open a PR and attach a tiny repro.

ryan: Happy to pair on the repro and the PR. Quick reminder: add an index.d.ts at root that re-exports the stable surface for IDEs while exports map handles runtime.

mia: Cool. I'll post the repro link once ready. Thanks! :v:
